name: MedSim
summary:
**A hospital in your headset.** Walk into the Residents' Room, choose a patient from the board, and Amal, your nurse, takes you to them.

**Talk to your patients.** Ask anything in your own words. Each patient answers in character, in English or Egyptian, Saudi or Iraqi Arabic.

**Examine with your hands.** Look at the eyes and mouth, listen to the heart and lungs, and read the monitor.

**See inside.** Open a window on the chest onto the beating heart and breathing lungs, and see what the illness has done.
